jobs.title: Director - Technology
jobs.description:
Overview

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

This Director role is part of the Audit Technology & Transformation team within KPMG Canada’s Audit practice, leading technology strategy, innovation, and transformation initiatives. The role partners with Audit leadership and technology stakeholders to advance AI, data, analytics, automation, and emerging technology solutions that support the modernization of the Audit practice.

What You Will Do

Lead the development and execution of the Audit Technology & Transformation strategy, aligning technology initiatives with the evolving needs of the Audit practice.
Provide leadership across AI, data and analytics, automation, and emerging technologies, identifying opportunities to modernize and enhance audit delivery.
Partner with Audit leadership, technology teams, and other stakeholders to design and implement scalable technology solutions.
Oversee technology transformation initiatives from strategy through implementation, ensuring appropriate governance, prioritization, and delivery.
Build and maintain strong relationships across the firm to enable collaboration and adoption of new technologies and ways of working.
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team, creating an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives and experiences are valued.
Monitor technology and industry trends and assess opportunities to responsibly introduce innovative solutions within the Audit practice.
Support effective change management and stakeholder engagement to drive successful adoption of technology-enabled solutions.

What You Bring To The Role

Education University degree in technology, computer science, engineering, business, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
Experience Senior leadership experience delivering large-scale technology transformation within a complex professional or enterprise environment.
Technical expertise Strong knowledge of AI, data and analytics, automation, cloud technologies, and emerging technology, with experience translating these capabilities into practical business solutions
Delivery Demonstrated experience leading technology initiatives from strategy and planning through implementation and adoption, including governance and stakeholder management.
Leadership Proven ability to lead and develop teams and collaborate effectively with senior business and technology stakeholders in a complex organization

KPMG Ontario Region Pay Range Information

The expected base salary range for this position is $117,000 - $196,000 and may be eligible for bonus awards. The determination of an applicant’s base salary within this range is based on the individual’s location, skills, & competencies, and unique qualifications. In addition, KPMG offers a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards program.

Providing you with the support you need to be at your best

Our Values, The KPMG Way

Integrity
, we do what is right | Excellence
, we never stop learning and improving | Courage
, we think and act boldly | Together
, we respect each other and draw strength from our differences | For Better
, we do what matters

KPMG in Canada is a proud equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive and barrier-free workplace that allows all of our people to reach their full potential. A diverse workforce is key to our success and we believe in bringing your whole self to work. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply and hope you will choose KPMG in Canada as your employer of choice.

Adjustments and accommodations throughout the recruitment process

At KPMG, we are committed to fostering an inclusive recruitment process where all candidates can be themselves and excel. We aim to provide a positive experience and are prepared to offer adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best. Adjustments (informal requests), such as extra preparation time or the option for micro breaks during interviews, and accommodations (formal requests), such as accessible communication supports or technology aids, are tailored to individual needs and role requirements. You will have an opportunity to request an adjustment or accommodation at any point throughout the recruitment process. If you require support, please contact KPMG’s Employee Relations Service team by calling 1-888-466-4778.

AI Usage

We embrace the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the candidate experience and streamline our recruitment processes. AI tools may help with organizing applications or surfacing relevant qualifications. However, no hiring decisions are made using AI. Every hiring decision is made by our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are equipped with training that empowers them to use these tools responsibly. AI technologies used in our recruitment process undergo detailed risk assessments, including security and privacy requirements, that align with KPMG’s Trusted AI framework.

We believe technology should empower human judgment, not replace it. It’s one of the many ways we’re delivering on our vision of being a technology-first, people-driven firm.

jobs.title: Director Credit Decisioning & Risk Strategies
jobs.description:
About Haventree Bank

Haventree Bank is a Schedule I Canadian bank dedicated to advancing financial security and upward mobility for Canadians underserved by traditional financial services. Through our broker-distributed alternative mortgage and GIC solutions, as well as our growing digital banking platform, we provide straightforward products that support long-term financial well-being and meaningful growth.

As a CDIC-insured, federally regulated bank, we offer the trust and stability of a traditional financial institution while embracing the innovation and customer-first mindset of a modern digital bank.

If you're looking for a place where your work has a direct impact, your ideas are valued, and innovation is encouraged, Haventree Bank is the place for you.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Chief Risk Officer, the Director – Credit Decisioning & Risk Strategy is accountable for the design, oversight, and continuous evolution of the Bank’s credit decision frameworks, credit risk policies, and portfolio risk strategy across mortgage origination and account management activities. The role provides senior leadership of forward-looking credit risk management, ensuring alignment with risk appetite, regulatory expectations, and strategic growth objectives.

Major Duties & Responsibilities

Own and evolve credit decision strategies, frameworks, and methodologies across the mortgage lifecycle.
Design, approve, and optimize automated and risk-based decisioning strategies, including rules, scorecards, and analytics.
Maintain ownership of Residential Mortgage Underwriting Policy and ensure regulatory alignment.
Chair and drive the Credit Risk Committee and related governance forums.
Oversee portfolio monitoring, concentration analysis, dashboards, and KRIs.
Provide senior oversight of Quality Assurance programs aligned to decision quality.
Translate credit analytics and model outputs into actionable risk insights.
Partner with Operations, Finance, Compliance, ERM, and Technology teams on credit initiatives.
Mentor and provide strategic leadership to credit strategy and insights teams.
Mortgage collections, delinquency management, or default resolution
Recoveries, legal enforcement, or loss mitigation execution
Day-to-day servicing or arrears operations

Qualifications & Experience

Degrees, Diplomas & Certifications:

University degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Math, Statistics, or related discipline.

Years and Range of Experience Required to Perform the Job:

10+ years of experience in Consumer (secured & unsecured) Credit Risk Management.
7+ years of senior leadership and people management experience.
Strong experience with automated decisioning, analytics, and regulatory governance.

jobs.title: Associate Director - Structured Finance Ratings, Esoteric Assets, New York, Chicago, Denver, or Toronto
jobs.description:
About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use):

12

The Team

Credit Ratings is an integral part of the Global Ratings Services team, comprising a diverse group of 1,400 analysts spread across key financial hubs worldwide. We are dedicated to delivering high-quality insights and exceptional client service across all industry sectors. 

The Esoteric ABS team assigns credit ratings to securities backed by non-traditional collateral like corporate securitizations, data centres, triple-net leases, transportation assets, De-Fi, etc. by analysing underlying asset performance, structural protections, cash-flow mechanics, and downside stress scenarios. Analysts produce opinions that help issuers and investors compare complex instruments, bringing market-relevant perspectives on topics such as performance trends, issuance conditions, and AI’s role in origination and securitization. 

The Impact

At S&P Global, our values - Discovery, Integrity, and Partnership - shape how we work, how we collaborate, and how we earn trust with our customers and each other. We embrace AI as an enabler, guided by rigorous governance and risk management, to enhance what has always defined us: the intelligence of our people, deep relationships, and trusted insights. By leveraging technology with human expertise, we help our teams navigate complexity and deliver actionable, decision-ready intelligence without compromising quality, accountability, or integrity.

What You Stand To Gain

At S&P Global Ratings, you will contribute to independent credit opinions the market relies on, strengthened by innovation that accelerates analysis.

We are People Forward. When you join S&P Global, you’ll benefit from:

Joining a diverse community where your growth and well-being come first—just like the 35,000+ colleagues who choose S&P Global every day.
Bringing your best self to work in an environment that values inclusion, collaboration, and authentic engagement.
Celebrating your achievements with us. We’re committed to your continuous learning, offering education, training, and career coaching to help you grow and adapt in a changing world.
Connecting through our People Resource Groups, which foster awareness, engagement, and a sense of community—both within S&P Global and beyond.

Responsibilities

Team Contribution & Capability Building

Act as senior reference point coaching (Research Assistants, Rating Analysts and Senior Analysts) on credit fundamentals, modelling discipline, data quality, and standard work including how to use AI as an enabler with governance.
Coordinate work across credits; anticipate capacity/quality risks; influence outcomes through planning and constructive challenge in ambiguous situations.
Embed continuous improvement into routines by improving playbooks/SOPs/prompt libraries and driving adoption.
Partner with stakeholders to identify and shape high-impact use cases, supporting testing/adoption/rollout with governance, controls, and change management.
Fosters a critical thinking mindset challenging assumptions and the status quo to generate insights that shape market views and strategic decisions.
Model enterprise behaviors: Discovery, Integrity, and Partnership including human-centric leadership alongside AI-enabled change.

Core Analytical & Delivery

Deliver end-to-end analytical execution across a defined portfolio, setting a consistently high bar for quality, timeliness, and clarity to sustain customer trust.
Lead surveillance and analytical updates, connecting performance, market developments, and issuer peers to forward-looking risk themes.
Own the quality of key outputs, ensuring consistency and clarity of reasoning.
Use approved GenAI/LLMs to accelerate research/comparisons/drafting.
Operate effectively alongside AI agents in recurring workflows.
Support the execution of AI-driven projects.
Validate inputs, reconcile metrics, document assumptions/model changes.

Stakeholder & Market Engagement

Synthesizes data, analysis, and research into executive-ready, market-facing narratives that convey S&P’s analytical expertise—leveraging broad market knowledge and detailed analysis to deliver trusted advice that influences decisions.
Builds collaborative stakeholder trust through empathetic communication, differentiates S&P’s market viewpoint, and drives engagement with market participants.
Contribute to strategic initiatives and also thought leadership by researching, drafting, and refining content with senior team input.

Risk Management and Operating

Ensure adherence to methodology/confidentiality/data governance requirements; escalate emerging risks early.
Embed responsible AI use in workflow process.
Drive controlled automation/agentic workflows to remove low-leverage work, defining requirements/controls and partnering with Data/Engineering to scale safely while setting expectations for ongoing monitoring and human oversight.

Compensation/Benefits Information: (
This section is only applicable to US candidates:)  
S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $110,000 USD to $193,000 USD. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses, and certifications. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please click here.  

Compensation/Benefits Information:
 (This section is only applicable to Canadian candidates:)  S&P Global states that the anticipated range of compensation for this position is 110,000 CAD to 172,000 CAD. Final compensation for this role will be based on the individual’s performance, geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses, and certifications. In accordance with Ontario's new regulations effective January 1, 2026, this job posting provides information on expected compensation. S&P Global will not be utilizing artificial intelligence in our hiring process. Additionally, we are committed to transparency and will inform all interviewed candidates of hiring decisions within 45 days of their interview. This posting is for an existing vacancy, and we encourage you to reach out for further information regarding our hiring practices or any questions you may have. Thank you for considering a career with us!

What We’re Looking For

Practice Nuances

Complete the end-to-end ratings process for new issue and surveillance transactions.
Perform cash flow analysis, synthesize results, and present findings in a timely manner in committees for various non-traditional assets, including transportation ABS, private equity, triple NNN, data centres, time-share, whole business, and De-Fi transactions.
Analyse credit, cash flow, and performance characteristics of collateral pools. Review third-party model output and reconcile with cash flow results from internal models.
Review legal and operating documents to ensure consistency with criteria and identify issues with the transaction structure. Provide comments to external parties.
Actively manage relationships with internal and external clients.
Demonstrate strong knowledge of ratings criteria and cash flow analysis and be able to handle clients’ analytical questions.
Actively contribute to our training and outreach efforts, including the completion of timely commentaries, podcasts, and webinars.

Team Contribution & Capability Building

Execution maturity across credit portfolio; delivers high quality with limited oversight.
Strong collaboration/communication; influences through credibility and constructive challenge.
Proven coaching/mentorship; develops juniors through feedback and quality review and reinforces human accountability in AI-enabled work.
Continuous improvement mindset with evidence of simplifying processes through standardization, tooling, and automation.
Comfortable with ambiguity and change, adapting quickly as processes/tools evolve.
Ability to scale automation/agent workflows by defining problems, supporting testing/UAT, identifying controls, and enabling adoption.

Core Analytical & Delivery

Strong research/data/credit/financial analysis; translates complexity into decision-useful narratives grounded in evidence and judgement.
Strong understanding of the financial services environment and ability to connect developments to emerging risk themes.
Practical AI fluency: experience embedding GenAI/LLMs and agentic workflows to increase productivity/insight as an enabler of human expertise, paired with disciplined validation, governance, and judgement.
Strong analytical tool capability; willingness to learn data/automation tools to oversee AI-enabled production.

Stakeholder & Market Engagement

Effective written and verbal skills for committee-ready documentation/presentation and interactions with issuers, investors and market participants.

Risk Management and Operating

High standards for accuracy, traceability, and governance; consistent adherence to methodology/documentation/confidentiality expectations.
Sound judgement on responsible AI/automation (validation, bias/hallucination awareness, data protection, attribution, approved boundaries).

Additional Information

An S&P Global employee at this level would typically have five to ten years’ of relevant work experience.
Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required. A master’s degree or professional certification (such as CFA) is highly valued. We welcome candidates from traditional finance disciplines as well as diverse academic backgrounds that support innovative and critical thinking.
Employees are required to work from the office a minimum of two days per week.
Candidates who reach the final stage of the interview process will be asked to attend at least one in-person interview at their nearest S&P Global Ratings office before an offer can be extended.

About S&P Global Ratings

At S&P Global Ratings, our analyst-driven credit ratings, research, and sustainable finance opinions provide critical insights that are essential to translating complexity into clarity so market participants can uncover opportunities and make decisions with conviction. By bringing transparency to the market through high-quality independent opinions on creditworthiness, we enable growth across a wide variety of organizations, including businesses, governments, and institutions.

S&P Global Ratings is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global is the world’s foremost provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity and automotive markets. With every one of our offerings, we help many of the world’s leading organizations navigate the economic landscape so they can plan for tomorrow, today.

For more information, visit www.spglobal.com/ratings

What’s In It For
You?

Our Mission

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

Our People

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

Our Values

Integrity, Discovery, Partnership

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Director, Americas, Life Sciences Vertical
jobs.description:
Change the future with us.

Our Sales experts are the eyes and ears of our customers. They do not wait; they take the initiative. They transform “That sounds interesting!” into actual contracts, paving the way for new avenues of business. Join our team and we will give you the latest knowledge and independence for autonomous action and decision-making, helping you become a trusted partner in customer relationships.

Why you’ll love working for Siemens!

Freedom and a healthy work- life balance– Embrace our flexible work environment with flex hours, telecommuting and digital workspaces.
Solve the world’s most significant problems – Be part of exciting and innovative projects.
Engaging, challenging, and fast evolving, cutting edge technological environment.
Opportunities to advance your career and mentorship programs on a local and global scale.
Competitive total rewards package.
Profit sharing available.
Rewarding vacation entitlement with the opportunity to buy and sell your vacation depending on your lifestyle.
Contribute to our social responsibility initiatives focused on access to education, access to technology and sustaining communities and make a positive impact on the community.
Participate in our celebrations, social events and offsite business events.
Opportunities to contribute your innovative ideas and get paid for them!
Employee perks and discounts.
Diversity and inclusivity focused.

Siemens is proud to be an eight-time award winner of Canada’s Top 100 Employers, Canada’s Greenest Employers 2025 and Canada’s Top Employers for Young People 2025.

What will you do?

The Director, Americas, Life Sciences Vertical
is responsible for driving the execution of Siemens’ growth strategy across the Life Sciences market throughout the Americas. This role partners closely with sales, domain, and technical teams as well as our global Vertical team to develop go-to-market plans, accelerate pipeline growth, replicate successful solutions across countries, and strengthen customer engagement with key accounts and strategic partners. As the Life Sciences subject matter expert, the Director will also provide strategic industry guidance, foster collaboration across local business units, and help align Siemens’ portfolio with evolving market and customer needs.

Driving the execution of the Americas Life Sciences vertical growth strategy by translating zone priorities into country-level go-to-market plans, pipeline actions, and targeted sales plays.
Aligning Siemens offerings, including automation, digitalization, software, lifecycle services, and control solutions, to address the specific needs of Life Sciences customers across the region.
Identifying, developing, and scaling high-impact use cases and lighthouse opportunities that accelerate growth and strengthen Siemens’ position in the Life Sciences market.
Building and leading a collaborative Life Sciences expert community across the Americas countries, connecting sales, domain, and technical specialists to share best practices, replicate successful applications, and drive coordinated pursuit strategies.
Accelerating pipeline growth and opportunity conversion through early engagement with key accounts, engineering partners, and other strategic ecosystem partners, supporting complex pursuits, and driving the replication of successful customer solutions across multiple countries.
Serving as the Life Sciences subject matter expert and strategic advisor, providing industry expertise to sales teams and leadership while ensuring market needs are reflected in portfolio feedback and future offering development.

What will you need to succeed?

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Industrial Technology, Life Sciences, or a related field.
10+ years of sales, account management, business development, or industry leadership experience within the Life Sciences sector, including pharmaceutical, biotechnology, biopharmaceutical, or related regulated manufacturing environments.
Proven track record of driving business growth, achieving sales objectives, and managing strategic customer relationships within complex industrial environments.
Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies, strategic account plans, pipeline growth initiatives, complex sales pursuits, and lifecycle business models.
Strong knowledge of industrial and/or process automation, digitalization, control systems, software, instrumentation, electrical solutions, or related industrial technologies, with the ability to align technical and commercial solutions to customer needs.

About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use):

The Team

Credit Ratings is an integral part of the Global Ratings Services team, comprising a diverse group of 1,400 analysts spread across key financial hubs worldwide. We are dedicated to delivering high-quality insights and exceptional client service across all industry sectors. 

The Esoteric ABS team assigns credit ratings to securities backed by non-traditional collateral like corporate securitizations, data centres, triple-net leases, transportation assets, De-Fi, etc. by analysing underlying asset performance, structural protections, cash-flow mechanics, and downside stress scenarios. Analysts produce opinions that help issuers and investors compare complex instruments, bringing market-relevant perspectives on topics such as performance trends, issuance conditions, and AI’s role in origination and securitization. 

The Impact

At S&P Global, our values - Discovery, Integrity, and Partnership - shape how we work, how we collaborate, and how we earn trust with our customers and each other. We embrace AI as an enabler, guided by rigorous governance and risk management, to enhance what has always defined us: the intelligence of our people, deep relationships, and trusted insights. By leveraging technology with human expertise, we help our teams navigate complexity and deliver actionable, decision-ready intelligence without compromising quality, accountability, or integrity.

What You Stand To Gain

At S&P Global Ratings, you will contribute to independent credit opinions the market relies on, strengthened by innovation that accelerates analysis.

We are People Forward. When you join S&P Global, you’ll benefit from:

Joining a diverse community where your growth and well-being come first—just like the 35,000+ colleagues who choose S&P Global every day.
Bringing your best self to work in an environment that values inclusion, collaboration, and authentic engagement.
Celebrating your achievements with us. We’re committed to your continuous learning, offering education, training, and career coaching to help you grow and adapt in a changing world.
Connecting through our People Resource Groups, which foster awareness, engagement, and a sense of community—both within S&P Global and beyond.

Responsibilities

Team Contribution & Capability Building

Embed continuous improvement into routines by improving playbooks/SOPs/prompt libraries and driving adoption.
Partner with stakeholders to identify and shape high-impact use cases, supporting testing/adoption/rollout with governance, controls, and change management.
Fosters a critical thinking mindset challenging assumptions and the status quo to generate insights that shape market views and strategic decisions.
Model enterprise behaviors: Discovery, Integrity, and Partnership including human-centric leadership alongside AI-enabled change.

Core Analytical & Delivery

Deliver end-to-end analytical execution across a defined portfolio, setting a consistently high bar for quality, timeliness, and clarity to sustain customer trust.
Lead surveillance and analytical updates, connecting performance, market developments, and issuer peers to forward-looking risk themes.
Own the quality of key outputs, ensuring consistency and clarity of reasoning.
Use approved GenAI/LLMs to accelerate research/comparisons/drafting.
Operate effectively alongside AI agents in recurring workflows.
Support the execution of AI-driven projects.
Validate inputs, reconcile metrics, document assumptions/model changes.

Stakeholder & Market Engagement

Synthesizes data, analysis, and research into executive-ready, market-facing narratives that convey S&P’s analytical expertise—leveraging broad market knowledge and detailed analysis to deliver trusted advice that influences decisions.
Builds collaborative stakeholder trust through empathetic communication, differentiates S&P’s market viewpoint, and drives engagement with market participants.
Contribute to strategic initiatives and also thought leadership by researching, drafting, and refining content with senior team input.

Risk Management and Operating

Ensure adherence to methodology/confidentiality/data governance requirements; escalate emerging risks early.
Embed responsible AI use in workflow process.
Drive controlled automation/agentic workflows to remove low-leverage work, defining requirements/controls and partnering with Data/Engineering to scale safely while setting expectations for ongoing monitoring and human oversight.

Complete the end-to-end ratings process for new issue and surveillance transactions.

Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required. A master’s degree or professional certification (such as CFA) is highly valued. We welcome candidates from traditional finance disciplines as well as diverse academic backgrounds that support innovative and critical thinking.

At S&P Global Ratings, our analyst-driven credit ratings, research, and sustainable finance opinions provide critical insights that are essential to translating complexity into clarity so market participants can uncover opportunities and make decisions with conviction. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible
